book.name: Jon
book.title: Yesu Kalisi-te banye nivasa lohvu Jon kaavu

content: Lasalus yimb
+ o 11:1 Luk 10:38-39*Omaaho ti haale nambe Lasalus nilak-ambe neep vu bayêên Betaani sen Malia yuuh halivêêh Maata baand-ato,
+ o 11:2 Jon 12:3*ond Maliaa-ju sen kaasêêh va galovasa lak Omaaho Bop vaha de laavu lak luvalus-ato ond mangwa Lasalus nilak.
+ o 11:3 Jon 11:36*Om vanga yuuh lawiing vakasin la vu Yesu nambe, “Omaaho Bop, omaaho sen gahem naving yi lôôt-ato ond nilak-ambe neep.”
+ o 11:4 Jon 9:3; 11:40*Yesu hango vakasin-anju tombe nêêl nambe, “Nilakin-anju me-nambe omaahôô-ju jimb e, malis, nganjo wiingin nambe biing Anutu banye jak, in nambe le biing Anutu Noow banye jak.”
Yesu yoo ahe having Maata yuuh halivêêh-ande Lasalus.
Ke, tombe hango nambe Lasalus nilak, le ma de yoo nando taaku sen nandôô-juuto busin yuuh having,
le mem nêêl vu yite maanggêêm-aso nambe, “Yanaah Yudia.”
+ o 11:8 Jon 8:59; 10:31*Le yite maanggêêm-aso lanêêl vu nambe, “Kaputung, mu naahen vasêên dakaa-ju hil Yuda lawiingin nambe lanyiis hong ak tatuuh-ato, le sim onavu ganaah-anju jesin a?”
+ o 11:9 Jon 9:4-5; 12:35*Le Yesu nêêl laah vu sil nambe, “Busin ti ond yite taaku me nomaayuuh-ambe laam yuuh, nambe omaaho ti na langaah ond me-le tayak e, in nayi taaku langaah vu voon,
+ o 11:10 1; Jon 2:11*le naambe na dôôk busin ond le tayak in mekanu
+ o 11:11 Mat 9:24*Om nêêl nambêênju vu sil vêêl e, le sim nêêl vu sil nambe, “Yate omaaho Lasalus neep me, lemu sana aanjêêvu.”
Le yite maanggêêm-aso lanêêl vu nambe, “Omaaho Bop, neep me ond yoo le kandi.”
Vakasin-anjo Yesu nêêl nambe Lasalus yimb, le sil akand vu nambe mak Yesu nêêl nambe Lasalus yoo neep malis amu.
Om Yesu nêêl langaah vu sil nambe, “Lasalus yimb,
lemu sa kangg navu ham-ambe sa longgpayo nivasa in same ala nando having yi le, in saawiingin nambe ham alompayo naam timu vu sa, om yana aangge yi le.”
+ o 11:16 Mak 14:31*Tombe Tomas sen danêêl nambe Papinj-ato ond nêêl vu maanggêêm-aso vaalu nambe, “Ham-o, yana be yaanggimb gaving yi.”
Yesu tu hil yimbin kandi jak osin metumin-ate danggakook
Tombe Yesu-so mondala be lala lalup, de lango nambe lambe Lasalus la bandumb-ambe busin yumbeyuuh lung la.
+ o 11:18 Mat 21:17*Bayêên Betaanii-ju neep ngaaho vu Yelusalem lohvu 3 kilomita mu.
Tombe hil Yuda ngeeyaata lala vu Maata yuuh Malia in nambe lambiing-ambe yuuh alondpayo nivasa jak in yuuhate mangwaandin yimb.
Tombe Maata hango banye nambe Yesu valup, om la hato vu Yesu vu mopaatôôv de Malia yoo nando bayêên.
+ o 11:21 Jon 11:32*Tombe Maata nêêl vu Yesu nambe, “Omaaho Bop, nambe omandôô-jo ond sa mangwaangg-ame le jimb e.
De gêên-anjo sa lak ni having nambe okataangg Anutu in vati, ond Anutu le bu vu hong.”
Tombe Yesu nêêl vu nambe, “Mangwaam e kandi jak.”
+ o 11:24 Jon 5:29; 6:39-40*Le Maata nêêl nambe, “Êê-e, sa lak ni nambe vu busin taamusin sen omaahonôôn pin kandi jak-ato ond le kandi jak gaving.”
Tombe Yesu nêêl laah vu nambe, “Kandi jak naah osin metumin yoo danggakook sa. Hil sen lambiing gaving sa be lanjimb-ato ond sil e mando metumin,
+ o 11:26 Jon 8:51*de hil sen dando metumin-ambe dawii-having saa-to ond sil-ame le lanjimb e, malis lôôt. Gawii-having vakasin-anjo me malis?”

+ o 11:27 Jon 6:69*Le Maata nêêl vu Yesu nambe, “Êê-e Omaaho Bop, saawii-having hong lung la nambe hong omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin hong vulôôt-ato. Hong Anutu Noow, omaaho sen Anutu nêêl nambe le naam voon-ato ond yik hong-anja.”
Yesu su
Maata nêêl vakasin-anju lung la tonde la teey halivêêh Malia, tombe la pataalang vu nambe, “Kaputung valup-ambe nalingin hong.”
Malia hango nambêênju tombe kandi lak pavis-ambe la vu Yesu,
+ o 11:30 Jon 11:20*de Yesu me-tok laam bayêên e, nganjo yoo naahen taaku sen Maata la hato vuu-to.

Tombe hil Yuda sen dando mondakaas having Malia hôôk bayêên alo in nambe lopayo nivasa jak-ato, ond layi nambe Malia kandi lak pavis-ambe la voon, tombe sil taamuyin, in sil akand vu nambe mak navu na naasu jak bandumb.

+ o 11:32 Jon 11:21*Tombe Malia la hato taaku sen Yesu naalêê-to, om yi Yesu tombe hato pataav baambu neep voon hôôk Yesu vaha de nêêl vu nambe, “Omaaho Bop, nambe omandôô-jo ond sa mangwaangg-ame le jimb e.”
Tombe Yesu yi de Malia nasu, tonde hil Yuda sen laving Malia be lalaam-ato ond yik dasu having, tombe ka paya de lopayo nimeen lôôt.
Tonde lingin nambe, “Ham hambe neep tana?” Le lanêêl nambe, “Omaaho Bop, ganaam gangge le.”
+ o 11:35 Luk 19:41*Tombe Yesu su.
+ o 11:36 Jon 11:3*Om hil Yuda lanêêl nambe, “Ham angge, yoo ahe having omaahôô-ju lôôt.”
+ o 11:37 Jon 9:6*Lemu hil vaalu lanêêl nambe, “Omaahôô-ju wiing-ambe mekanôônd ame tum-ato, om me-lohvu nambe dôôvu yite omaahôô-ju in nambe me-jimb e?”
Yesu wiing-ambe Lasalus kandi lak laah
+ o 11:38 Mat 27:60*Tombe Yesu lopayo nimeen lôôt yesin laah tonde la valup bandumb, de bandumb-anju ond lavandangga ti tombe sil tatolin tatuuh ti hilin avi jeen.
Tombe Yesu nêêl nambe, “Ham baaku tatuuh-anja na vêêl.” Le Maata sen yimbin vangaa-to nêêl vu nambe, “Omaaho Bop, yimb-ambe neep busin yumbeyuuh lung la om ninggalôôn ak.”
+ o 11:40 Jon 11:4,23-26*Tombe Yesu nêêl vu nambe, “Le saanêêl vu hong gêên-ato nambe gambiing gaving ond onavu gangge Anutu-te niwêêk.”
Tombe laaku tatuuh la vêêl, de me lak baandoni de nêêl nambe, “Aamangg, sa naapêêlis vu hong in ohango sate lohakin lung laa-to.

+ o 11:42 Jon 12:30*De sa lak ni nambe lak busin pin ond goo nambe nanyem in sate lohakin, lemu sa kangg vu hil sen daalêê-jo ondeey saanêêl vakasin-anjo in nambe sil lambiing gaving naambe goo gawiing sa be sa laam.”
Nêêl nambêênju tonde teey bopaata nambe, “Lasalus, ganaam voon.”

Tombe yimbin kandi lak-ambe laam voon osin tôômb sen sil lavil nama yuuh vaha lak-ato, de tôômb daka sen hilin mêê-to ond yik yoo neep ak yi having. Tombe Yesu nêêl nambe, “Ham kavaayin tôômb na vêêl-ande yoo na.”
Hil lanjôôy vakasin in nambe lanyiis Yesu be jimb
+ o 11:45 Jon 4:48; 7:31; Luk 16:31*Tombe hil Yuda vaalu sen lalaam vu Maliaa-to layi vaa-ju tombe sil ngeeyaata lawii-having Yesu,
lemu sil vaalu lala vu hil Palisai be lanêêl va sen Yesu wiing-anjôôto banye vu sil.

Tombe kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv-aso laving hil Palisai be yoo lasupin sil having kaansol-aso be lanêêl nambe, “Yale aambiing naambe vaati? In omaahôô-ju wiing taahu taahu osin niwêêk ngeeyaata.
Yiiy oo monaangge mu de yoo monambiing va naambêênju, ond hil pin e lambiing gaving yi, de hil Lom e lanaam-ambe kawiiy Anutu-te dumb bop osin yiiy pin na.”
Tombe sil ti haale nambe Kaiapas tu kul vaha salivangin-ate yêêv bop hôôk ta tii-ju, ond nêêl vu sil nambe, “Ham-ame alak ni daka le,
+ o 11:50 Jon 18:14*de ham-ame kam vu va sen dôôvu ham-ato le? Nambe omaaho timu jimb in dôôvu hil pin ond mem, de yate hil pin-ame lanjimb e.”

+ o 11:51 Jen 50:20*Vakasin-anjo ond me-yoo nêêl lohvu ka le, malis, nganjo tu yêêv bop salivangin-ate hôôk ta tii-ju om nêêl vakasin langaah nambe Anutu-te omaaho ti, ond nêêl lak Yesu nambe le jimb in dôôvu hil Yuda.
+ o 11:52 Jon 10:16; 17:21; 1Jon 2:2*Lemu me-yoo jimb in hil Yuda yoow e, malis, jimb in naasupin Anutu-te noondin pin sen dando lohvu taaku pin-ato be sil daatu dangga timu.
+ o 11:53 Jon 5:18*Tombe yik hôôk busin-anju sil davu salo mop in nambe lanyiis Yesu be jimb,

+ o 11:54 Jon 7:1*om Yesu me-nando langaah hôôk hil Yuda mend yesin laah e, nganjo havuuh taakuu-ju de la taaku ti danêêl nambe Eplaim. Taakuu-ju neep ngaaho vu taaku lumbalaamb, tombe la nandôô-ju having yite maanggêêm-aso.

+ o 11:55 2Kro 30:17; Sin 21:26*Tonde hil Yuda-te busin bop busin haluusin sen Anutu haluuh hil Islel hôôk vu Ijip bôôy-ato ngaaho lak, tombe hil ngeeyaata vu taaku pin lala lalup Yelusalem in samu sil vêêl e.
+ o 11:56 Jon 7:11*Tombe sil davu salo Yesu, tonde lala daale Anutu-te dumb bop alo be mondanêêl vu sil nambe, “Ham akam vu nambe vaati, mak me-le naam-ambe ji busin bop-anjo gaving e?”
Tombe yêêv-aso salivangin-ate laving hil Palisai lanêêl nambe omaaho ti lak ni nambe Yesu nando tana, ond naanêêl banye langaah in lanôôh yi.

footnotes.text: Vakasin sen Yesu nêêl-anjo ond nanêêl vakasin pakwesin nalak yi nambe yite busin sen jimb-ato naahen om sil e lana nivasa.
